feature: Deck overview (sub-project 6), PR 5: a version's overview, from its expanded panel (6e)
note: Needs a server with ANALYSIS_TAB_ENABLED=true. VERSION_DECK is a deck whose newest version was committed with an overview (on local-dev, pin one with an insert into deck_version_synopses, as probe:synopsis-ui does, and remove it afterwards). Reached by pressing the Versions tab and then the row.

rows.label: /decks/[id] Versions: the expanded panel, with Overview for this version under the note (1300) and opening the panel under the row (390)
/decks/[id] Versions: the version's overview, read only, with its record line
